title: Nian et al. 2024: 5 and 20 kg of TNT before a 6 m RC blast wall
summary: A free-standing reinforced concrete wall 6 m long and 2.5 m high, a ground burst of 5 or 20 kg of TNT on its axis 3 m in front. Side-on peaks in the ground beside the charge, the reflected peak at the wall's foot, and side-on peaks 2 to 6 m behind the wall, where it shields.

sources.title: Experimental and numerical study on protective effect of RC blast wall against air shock wave
sources.used_for: The wall, the shots, the gauges and the measured peaks (text, Table 1, Table 4, and readings of Fig. 15)
sources.note: Only measured numbers are transcribed, with citation; no text or figures are reproduced.

redistribution.note: Measured peaks transcribed with citation from an open-access paper (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0); numbers only.

coordinates: Origin at the charge on the ground; x towards and through the wall along its axis, y along the wall, z up; metres. The wall's front face is at x = 3 m.

ground.description: Natural soil at the site with flush ground gauges; its properties are not given. Taken as flat.

obstacles.material: reinforced concrete (bars and strength not given)
obstacles.description: RC cantilever wall 6.0 m long, 2.5 m high, 0.4 m thick, an inverted T on a buried strip footing; no wing walls (sandbags piled at its ends). Undamaged after the 20 kg shot; no deflection measured.

scoring.note: Field gauges with large scatter (at 20 kg the first two read 1.5 and 0.65 of ConWep), so a wider factor; the gauges behind the wall are filtered records.

notes: There was no shot without the wall: the side-on gauges beside the charge stood in the same shots.

Several gauges behind the wall failed (5 kg: ph-2 invalid; 20 kg: ph-1 and ph-3 invalid). Those that read had abnormal signals, low-pass filtered at 2 kHz by the authors, so their peaks are lower bounds of uncertain size.
The time origin of the plotted records is not stated, so arrival times are not given.
The 20 kg reflected gauge p-1 at 3 m read 1.5 times ConWep's; the 5 kg reflected spike twice ConWep's.
